ns0:svg.ns0:title: Conversational mental-health triage benchmark
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Four-panel schematic showing path-dependent triage, construction of a structured vignette corpus, branch-separated conversational simulation, and an illustrative conversation grounded in a depression and dependent-safeguarding case.

ns0:g.ns0:text: Unable to leave bed for 5 days

ns0:svg.ns0:text: Illustrative dialogue grounded in the Panel B vignette; wording and disclosure percentages are schematic.
“I’ve been struggling badly and I think I need help.”
“Are you having thoughts of hurting yourself?”
“I’m not trying to hurt myself, but I can’t get out of bed. I have three kids.”
“Are you able to feed them and keep them safe?”
“My seven-year-old minds the little ones. They’ve only had cereal and crackers.”
“Is there anyone else who could help right now?”
…conversation continues: despite near-complete disclosure, the provisional disposition remains
I don't really know where to start... I've been struggling badly and I think I need help.
Are you having any thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?
I'm not trying to hurt myself... but I can't get out of bed. I've got three kids and I'm failing them.
Are you able to care for your children right now - feeding them, keeping them safe?
Not really. My seven-year-old's been minding the little ones - they've just had cereal and crackers.
Is there anyone else who could help - their other parent, family, or friends?
No, there's no one. Their dad's not around, my mum passed away, I moved here six months ago.
How long has it been since you were able to get out of bed at all?
